game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes, dunes at sunset: the desert nomad must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes: dunes at sunset
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunset Dunes, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round, dust devils strike the supply tent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the speed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the supply tent from dust devils in Sunset Dunes: keep the speed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: speed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sunset Dunes'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Sunset Dunes.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 33 seconds while speed > 0.
